# nrswa-ai-mcp

> UK street works compliance. Section 50 licences, S58 deferral, S74 overrun penalties, NRSWA accreditation tracking.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- check_s50_licence
- classify_works
- calculate_s74_overrun
- nrswa_accreditation_check
- noticing_timeline

## Install
```
pip install nrswa-ai-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/nrswa-ai-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
